title: Placement record slice: element names of the decision-record fact, the case read and the authorise call, the reference-data operation, the MSG-P7-009 text, the per-service login name and the platform contract rows are not in any source this story may read
source: Template and Rules v1 R4, R5.5 (DP-03, DP-07, DP-08, DP-09, DP-11, DP-14), R7.2 and R9; _work/msr/context/P7.md (service row, naming rules, ownership rows); 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epic 2 Story Files v5/RWB E2 036 Queue write interface for models and agents v1.md (sections 1 to 19); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD P7 Decision center and log v3.md (A2.1, A2.2, A2.3, A2.4, A2.5, A2.6, A2.7, A2.8); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P7 Decision center and log v2.md
section: 1 Story; 3 Preconditions; 8 Business rules (BR2, BR5, BR6); 10 Authority; 11 Data; 12.1, 12.2, 12.4 and 12.8 Contract; 13 Solution plan; 14 Validation and messages
description: No source in the set gives seven things this slice needs. One: the element names of the placement fact carried as rwb.decision-record.DecisionRecorded.v1 on rwb.decision-record.v1, which the owner of the local record publishes and this service consumes. Two: the request and answer shapes of the P3 case read and of the P4 authorise call behind the two ledger reads. Three: the operation path and the answer shape of the reference-data contract through which LOV-DECISION, the value D6 and the final-call form 'PLACED <queueCode>' are read with the version in force. Four: the text of MSG-P7-009, which FSD P7 v3 names by identifier only (A2.2.4.3, A2.3.4.2, A2.4.4.3 and A2.5.4.3). Five: the name of the per-service database login of DP-02. Six: the platform contracts the DP rows add (H RWB-PLT-E1027-CON, RWB-PLT-E1043-CON, RWB-PLT-E1037-CON, RWB-PLT-TE006-CON, RWB-PLT-E1047-CON, RWB-PLT-E1044-CON, RWB-PLT-N001-CON and the two C rows C RWB-P3-E1043-CON, C RWB-P4-E1037-CON), which are not in the metadata rows that copy the story line. Seven: which service owns the admission half of the key, since the legacy story places the endpoint in the P2 backlog and the code in recovery/casewf/placement (P3) while the WP places this slice in rwb-decision. The story therefore writes the placeholder 'Not specified in the source documents (CG-B2-P7-005-1; ASM-B2-P7-005-n)' wherever one of the seven sits and never invents the value.
evidence: The legacy story RWB-E2-036 gives the business values, the states, the rules and the messages only, and names no element of a Kafka fact, no authorise answer and no reference-data operation; FSD P7 v3 A2.1 to A2.8 name the decision entry fields and the message identifiers MSG-P7-001 to MSG-P7-009 but write out no text for MSG-P7-009 and no operation path for LOV-DECISION; TSD P7 v2 gives T3.1, T3.2, T6.1, T6.2 and T-A.1 for the ledger of E1 and names neither the placement fact nor the two consumed operations; the context pack gives the service row, the naming rules and the six owned tables with the 19 owned operations, three events, three jobs and one workflow, and gives no fact element and no login name; Architecture v5 slides 14, 20 and 41 name the owners and the topic but no shape.
owner_role: Solution architect, rwb-decision, with the rwb-integration and rwb-case contract owners
proposed: RWB-P2-E2036-CON publishes the placement fact on rwb.decision-record.v1 with its element names, its key and its CloudEvents envelope, and RWB-PLT-E1027-CON publishes the decision-record library signature; the P3 case-read and P4 authorise shapes and the reference-data operation are published in their own CON stories at wave 2 entry; the text of MSG-P7-009 is added to the message standard by the business analyst, P7, with the field naming kept as FSD P7 v3 has it; the platform DB story fixes the login name and the secret store entry; the two C rows and the seven H rows are carried in the Dependency Map as platform and published contracts and the story keeps Depends on (build) None, because the rules make only H blocking and every one of them is a wave-0 or published contract reached through its fake; the split boundary is fixed as ASM-B2-P7-005-1 so that the ledger slice of rwb-decision, the admission slice of rwb-integration and the placement slice of rwb-case never overlap.
